title: rust/lichen-rpl dodag.rs: reject-silently at MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES prevents adopting better parents
description: Python fix (project-LICHEN-worker6-dbdn) added MAX_PARENTS=16 with eviction of the worst non-preferred parent when a strictly better candidate arrives (dodag.py _make_room_for). Rust rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lines 449-456 instead silently drops any NEW candidate when at MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES=16 capacity, so a node at capacity can never replace a degraded parent with a genuinely better one until the parent is pruned by other means. Divergence from the Python eviction semantics; consider parity: evict highest path_cost non-preferred parent when incoming candidate is strictly better. Note rust ParentCandidate has no last_heard field.
